## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Paris, France. It starts at 78120.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The stunning Château de Rambouillet has welcomed some of the greatest figures in French history over the years. See the place that King Louis XVI and Marie-Antoinette, Napoleon I, Charles de Gaulle, and other prominent leaders all loved to escape to in the heart of a beautiful forest.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €12.22. It was rated 4.2 out of 5 from 102 ratings and 58 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
